newsitem.title: USA: OfficeMax to open store in Mexico City.
newsitem.headline: OfficeMax to open store in Mexico City.

text.p: OfficeMax Inc said Thursday that an OfficeMax TriMax Super Center will open tomorrow in Mexico City, Mexico.

The new TriMax is OfficeMax's first international joint venture and is operated by OfficeMax de Mexico, whose joint venture partners are OfficeMax and Grupo Oprimax, a Mexican corporation whose principals own and operate a variety of retail and commercial concerns, OfficeMax said.
The company said Mexico can potentially support over 50 OfficeMax superstores and will be used as a springboard for future expansion beyond the boundaries of the United States.
OfficeMax operates over 500 superstores and delivery centers in over 190 markets, in 43 states, Puerto Rico and, starting Friday, Mexico.
